column1: # mesh-dualboot 16 MB partition table for ESP32-S3 — NET-OTA variant.
# Identical to partitions.csv except `factory` grows from 0x60000 to
# 0x100000 to fit the selector + WiFi + lwIP + auth + UI when the
# MDB_NET_OTA feature is compiled in. Everything after `factory` shifts
# by 0xA0000. OTA slots stay 5.25 MB so firmware checkprogsize ceilings
# don't change. ~80 KB tail slack remains.
# Apps are 64 KB-aligned; data partitions are 4 KB-aligned.
# Slot assignment (unchanged; firmware-to-slot mapping is in slots.json):
#   factory  -> selector app (boot menu + net-OTA listener)
